description_en: Returns details of all missing indexes for an instance
description_zh: 调用GetInstanceMissingIndexList接口，查询RDS SQL Server实例所有缺失索引的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun das get-instance-missing-index-list --instance-id rm-t4nfalp2ap4210000 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --object-name bas_customer --reserved-size =_100 --row-count =_100000 --reserved-pages =_100 --index-count =_8 --unique-compiles =_10000 --user-seeks =_1000 --user-scans =_10000 --avg-total-user-cost =_8 --avg-user-impact 10000 --start-time 1679414400000 --end-time 1681869544000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInstanceMissingIndexList

parameters.help_en:
The database instance ID.

Only ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances are supported
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的页码，从1开始，默认为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the table size
parameters.help_zh: 表总空间筛选条件。单位为MB。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+表总空间大小`，例如筛选条件设置为查询总空间大于等于100M的表时，输入：`>=|100`
parameters.name: reserved_size

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the number of table rows
parameters.help_zh: 表记录数筛选条件。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+表记录数`，例如`>=|100`
parameters.name: row_count

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the total number of pages
parameters.help_zh: 总页数筛选条件。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+总页数`，例如`>=|100`
parameters.name: reserved_pages

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the number of indexes
parameters.help_zh: 索引个数（索引缺失表目前所拥有的索引个数）筛选条件。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+索引个数`，例如`>=|100`
parameters.name: index_count

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the number of compilations
parameters.help_zh: 编译次数筛选条件。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+编译次数`，例如`>=|100`
parameters.name: unique_compiles

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the number of seeks
parameters.help_zh: 查找次数筛选条件。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+查找次数`，例如`>=|100`
parameters.name: user_seeks

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the number of scans
parameters.help_zh: 扫描次数筛选条件。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+扫描次数`，例如`>=|100`
parameters.name: user_scans

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the average cost savings
parameters.help_zh: 平均开销节约百分比（预测建立了缺失索引后，用户的平均CPU开销节约百分比。）筛选条件。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+平均开销节约百分比`，例如筛选条件设置为查询平均开销节约百分比小于等于10%时，输入：`<=|10`
parameters.name: avg_total_user_cost

parameters.help_en: The query condition based on the performance improvement
parameters.help_zh: 性能提升百分比（预测建立了缺失索引后，用户的平均查询性能提升百分比。）筛选条件。输入格式为`运算符+分割服“|”+性能提升百分比`，例如筛选条件设置为查询性能提升百分比大于等于100%时，输入：`>=|100`
parameters.name: avg_user_impact

parameters.help_en: The start time of the last seek
parameters.help_zh: 索引最后查找时间的开始时间。格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the last seek
parameters.help_zh: 索引最后查找时间的结束时间。格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time
